title: Competence, Capability and Capacity
summary: How to test whether a candidate has the knowledge, experience and time the role requires, using evidence rather than assertion, and how to close gaps without lowering the standard.
contentGaps: Written as part of a programme: Aim and Purpose is the module's one-line description; audience, prior knowledge and core reading come from the programme

sections.Aim and Purpose: How to test whether a candidate has the knowledge, experience and time the role requires, using evidence rather than assertion, and how to close gaps without lowering the standard.
Learning Objectives: Assess competence against the role profile using documentary and interview evidence
Judge capacity, other commitments and conflicts of interest
Design development plans and conditions where gaps exist
Syllabus: Evidence of experience, qualifications and track record
Structured competency interviews and scenario questions
Time commitment, multiple directorships and conflicts of interest
Closing gaps: induction, development plans and conditional appointments
Intended Audience: Heads of compliance, company secretaries and governance teams who manage approved and certified roles
HR, talent and nominations committee support staff responsible for senior appointments and references
Senior managers and chairs who sponsor appointments and sign off fitness assessments
sections.Useful Prior Knowledge and Experience: Some experience of compliance, company secretarial, HR or governance work in a regulated firm is helpful. No prior experience of regulatory applications is required.
Core Reading: IOSCO, Objectives and Principles of Securities Regulation (2017)
FSB, Strengthening Governance Frameworks to Mitigate Misconduct Risk: A Toolkit for Firms and Supervisors (2018)
